subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should maintainers keep this draft as a proof-only target until a live Telegram artifact shows baseline missing or blocking the marker image and candidate delivering exactly one image?
rationale: Automation cannot decide whether the skipped Mantis run is acceptable proof or whether the split PR boundaries should be replaced by this combined stack.

options.title: Keep As Proof Target
options.body: Keep this PR open but non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs prove the baseline/candidate generated-image delta.

options.title: Accept Combined Boundary
options.body: Merge the stack only if maintainers intentionally want one combined implementation plus proof-harness landing and accept the bundled delivery and automation risk.

options.title: Close After Split Path Proceeds
options.body: Close this draft once proof is captured elsewhere or maintainers decide the split implementation and harness PRs are the only landing path.

recommendation.title: Keep As Proof Target
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, terminal live output, or logs prove the baseline/candidate generated-image delta.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is mostly about the Telegram/Mantis proof harness and proof sufficiency, where this handle has recent directly relevant history.
